_comment: Cross-client vector for the ADR-0028 group history seal. Generated against libsodium-wrappers (crypto_secretbox_easy), the same library the extension uses, with a FIXED key and nonce so this pins the construction rather than sampling it. Any client must reproduce blob.ciphertext byte for byte from key+nonce+plaintext, and open it back. keyId is base64url-nopad(SHA-256(utf8(key))), the same fingerprint rule as an endpoint public key.
